verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents webhooks across several product areas. Wallet webhooks give real-time notifications for transfers and signer exports, payments webhooks track order lifecycle and payment status, and authentication webhooks cover user events. The Agent Checkouts product, the most agent-specific one, has "no webhooks in v1" and is poll-only. Missing for 10: webhook coverage for Agent Checkouts and agent cards, documented signature verification, retry and delivery details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
